newsitem.title: POLAND: Novita surges after upping net forecast.
newsitem.headline: Novita surges after upping net forecast.

text.p: Polish carpet maker Novita SA surged 9.9 percent to 13.3 zlotys after upgrading its net profit forecast for this year traders said.
Novita raised its profit forecast on Friday to 6.1 million zlotys from the 5.4 million zlotys it predicted last October.
Demand for the stock after price-fixing was strong enough for players to have their bids reduced.
"The firm's forecast of earnings up about 50 percent from last year led to an emotional reaction," one trader said.
Last year Novita earned four million zlotys on sales of 67.6 million zlotys.
